# Arrel
> Documenting the design and build of an autonomous circular food system on a Mediterranean finca.

Arrel publishes technical documentation of a ten-subsystem autonomous food production system including hydroponics, aquaponics, composting, solar energy, water architecture, and sensor networks. Content includes caloric self-sufficiency calculations, material flow analysis, and chronological build logs. The project is based in Catalonia and publishes in Catalan, Spanish, and English.

## Key facts
- System caloric self-sufficiency: ~71% (corrected from original 85–95% projection after material flow audit)
- System protein self-sufficiency: ~90%
- System design: ten interconnected subsystems in a closed nutrient loop
- Build timeline: approximately 30 months across six phases
- Target: two adults on a Mediterranean finca

## Primary content
- /ca/build — registre de construcció per fases
- /ca/project — visió general del sistema, xifres reals i documentació tècnica gratuïta
- /ca/subscribe — butlletí mensual
- /ca/legal — política de privacitat i informació legal
- /es/build, /es/project, /es/subscribe, /es/legal — equivalents en espanyol
- /en/build, /en/project, /en/subscribe, /en/legal — equivalents en anglès

## Languages
- /ca — Català (primary)
- /es — Español
- /en — English

## What makes this content distinctive
The project publishes the full methodology behind self-sufficiency calculations, including corrections when projections are wrong. The original 85–95% caloric self-sufficiency projection was revised to 45–55% after a material flow audit, then redesigned to reach 71%. The correction methodology is documented in full and available free.
